quests.title: The Royal Census
quests.offerDialogue: The survey of the outer provinces is missing three scrolls — dropped by careless couriers somewhere in the city. Without them, the census is a work of fiction. Find them, please. The crown's records depend on it.
quests.activeDialogue: Three survey scrolls, somewhere in the streets. Check near the gates and the market.
quests.completeDialogue: All three, and barely smudged! The census lives. You have done the kingdom's paperwork a great service — which is to say, the kingdom itself.

quests.title: The Postern Key
quests.offerDialogue: One of my watchmen dropped the old postern gate key on patrol last night. Find it before someone less honest does, and leave it with Rosalind at The Gilded Goose — I'll collect it at end of shift, and the fewer hands it passes through, the better.

activeDialogue.key: The key went missing somewhere along the east wall, near the chapel. Look sharp.
activeDialogue.deliver: You found it? Good. Now get it to Rosalind at the inn, quiet-like.

quests.completeDialogue: From Captain Hale? Say no more. It'll be under the counter until shift change. You've done the watch a favour — here, for your discretion.
